title: File:First nights in Tokyo.webm
credit: Vimeo: First nights in Tokyo (view archived source)
description:
First nights in Tokyo was a trip I made in Japan during winter 2012. I had the chance to get unique shots of Shibuya covered in snow and experience Tokyo's exceptional nightlife for the first time.

The video covers a little of every popular places in Tokyo including a very nice bar called the Quest in roppongi. You will see timelapses seen from the mono rail starting in Odaiba ending in Shiodome, the Tokyo tower and Roppongi streets, Omotesando and Harajuku fashion shopping district with the prada building, Asaskusa's incredible temples and much more. Enjoy the trip as much as I did! Filmed and edited by Guillaume J. Lauzier guillaumelauzier.com Soundtrack by The Subs - Don't Stop (Autoerotique remix) Locations Tokyo, Roppongi, Shibuya, Shinjuku, Ueno, Asakusa, Omote-sando, Odaiba, Yokohama, Narita, Ginza, Ebisu, Harajuku, Akihabara, Meguro, Daimon, Kamiyacho, Shimbashi, Ikebukuro, Shiodome. Shot on

Canon 5d MkII
